About Alton 
Nestled at the southern tip of Lake Winnipesaukee, Alton, New Hampshire, offers the perfect blend of small-town charm and natural beauty. Known for its welcoming community, scenic waterfront, and year-round outdoor activities, Alton is a destination for both visitors and residents who enjoy boating, hiking, and a relaxed pace of life. With a rich history and a strong sense of local pride, Alton embodies the spirit of New England in every season.
